# The email lens: is this moment mine?

<!-- Region `email-lens`, recognition document. No identifiers on purpose: the question here is only whether the moment belongs to this region. -->

## What this region is

The email lens is the one vocabulary for everything a template does with a path or a rule: four per-root lenses (sender, recipient, data, system), scoped to the owner of the row and, at send, to the sender. Save, render, preflight and the rule builder all read it, so a rule that passes at save behaves the same at send.

## What it exists for

- Check what a rule in an email template may read and reference
- Resolve a token path through the email lens
- Build an email lens and scope it to what the sender may see
- Warn about paths a component expects that the lens does not provide

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Save an email template → email-templates
- Send an email to the user → email-delivery
- Where do I get a lens for this model → lenses
- Define a lens, save it, load it back → lens-model
- Run a user's rule safely under the lens → lens-usage
